compose.title: Seal your message on-chain.

options.pwd_placeholder: Enter password (recipient must know this to decrypt)

result.title: Sealed. The link is the key.
result.subtitle: Your message was encrypted in the browser and recorded on the blockchain. Keep the link safe — it is the only way to decrypt.

shareLink.title: Share Link
shareLink.qr_sub: Scan with a mobile device to decrypt. The key is in the URL fragment and never sent to the server.

vault.desc: This message was encrypted in the sender's browser. The server retains no backup. Once unlocked, the content is immediately destroyed on the server — only the blockchain hash remains.
vault.confirm: Opening this message counts as reading it. It will be destroyed immediately.
vault.pwd_label: This message is password-protected. Enter the password to unlock.
vault.integrity_fail_sub: SHA-256 hash mismatch — proceed with caution
vault.destruct: Leaving this page will permanently destroy the message. Time left:
vault.err_opened: This message has already been opened and cannot be read again.
vault.err_notfound: Message not found — it may have been destroyed.

vaultPage.title: Someone sealed a message for you.
vaultPage.subtitle: No one — not even BlockSeal — can read it until you unlock it. It disappears after reading.
